rows.note: Use this for the person directing a film, television programme, or stage production.

example.english: The director said this scene needs to be filmed again.
example.traditional: 導演話呢場戲要再拍一次。
example.jyutping: dou6 jin2 waa6 ni1 coeng4 hei3 jiu3 zoi3 paak3 jat1 ci3

rows.note: Use this for a person managing a department or organizational area, rather than a film director.

example.english: Our department director is off today.
example.traditional: 我哋部門主管今日請假。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2 gam1 jat6 cing2 gaa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the person in charge has no more specific title.

example.english: The director in charge of this project has not come back yet.
example.traditional: 呢個項目嘅負責人仲未返嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 fu6 zaak3 jan4 zung6 mei6 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a member of a company's board of directors.

example.english: The director voted for this plan.
example.traditional: 呢位董事投票贊成呢份計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 dung2 si6 tau4 piu3 zaan3 sing4 ni1 fan6 gai3 waak6
